text: Tuesday, eleven at night.
prefix: Tuesday, eleven at night.

text: Bekzod is connecting Malika's flower shop to the bank, and one test payment keeps failing.
prefix: Bekzod is connecting Malika's flower shop to the bank, and one test payment keeps failing.

text: To see why, he prints the whole request into a log file, token and all.
prefix: To see why, he prints the whole request into a log file, token and all.

text: In Lesson 19, his server traded the shop's secret for a short-lived token, and with that token it asks ecom to create payments.
prefix: In Lesson 19, his server traded the shop's secret for a short-lived token, and with that token it asks ecom to create payments.

text: This lesson is about why that token alone should never be enough.
prefix: This lesson is about why that token alone should never be enough.

text: A token says who you are.
prefix: A token says who you are.

text: It does not say that you wrote this particular request.
prefix: It does not say that you wrote this particular request.

text: And tokens leak, exactly like this one.
prefix: And tokens leak, exactly like this one.

text: Bekzod's log ends up in a support chat, and anyone who reads it now holds a working token.
prefix: Bekzod's log ends up in a support chat, and anyone who reads it now holds a working token.

text: With it, they can ask for a payment of any amount, and send the buyer back to any address they like.
prefix: With it, they can ask for a payment of any amount, and send the buyer back to any address they like.

text: There is a second danger.
prefix: There is a second danger.

text: Someone who records one honest request can simply send it again tomorrow.
prefix: Someone who records one honest request can simply send it again tomorrow.

text: Most teams stop at the token.
prefix: Most teams stop at the token.

text: I think that is the most common mistake in payment APIs, and the cheapest one to avoid.
prefix: I think that is the most common mistake in payment APIs, and the cheapest one to avoid.

text: What can Bekzod add to a request, so that a stolen token is worth nothing?
prefix: What can Bekzod add to a request, so that a stolen token is worth nothing?

text: So Bekzod's server seals every request.
prefix: So Bekzod's server seals every request.

text: That seal is the request signature.
prefix: That seal is the request signature.

text: It covers the method, which says create.
prefix: It covers the method, which says create.

text: It covers the full address the request goes to.
prefix: It covers the full address the request goes to.

text: It covers the token.
prefix: It covers the token.

text: It covers a fingerprint of the body, so the amount and the return address are sealed too.
prefix: It covers a fingerprint of the body, so the amount and the return address are sealed too.

text: And it covers the time and a one-time number.
prefix: And it covers the time and a one-time number.

text: Change any of them, and the seal no longer fits.
prefix: Change any of them, and the seal no longer fits.

text: The seal is made with a signing key.
prefix: The seal is made with a signing key.

text: That key is a secret held by only two parties: the bank and this one API client.
prefix: That key is a secret held by only two parties: the bank and this one API client.

text: The bank writes it straight into its key safe.
prefix: The bank writes it straight into its key safe.

text: The payments app can read it, but never change it, and no person ever types it into the app.
prefix: The payments app can read it, but never change it, and no person ever types it into the app.

text: When a request arrives, ecom checks it in a fixed order.
prefix: When a request arrives, ecom checks it in a fixed order.

text: First, the time must be fresh, inside the bank's chosen window.
prefix: First, the time must be fresh, inside the bank's chosen window.

text: Second, the body must match its fingerprint.
prefix: Second, the body must match its fingerprint.

text: Third, the API client named in the seal must be the one that owns the token.
prefix: Third, the API client named in the seal must be the one that owns the token.

text: Last, ecom makes the seal again with the same key and compares the two.
prefix: Last, ecom makes the seal again with the same key and compares the two.

text: Only then does it spend the one-time number.
prefix: Only then does it spend the one-time number.

text: That number is the nonce, and each nonce works once.
prefix: That number is the nonce, and each nonce works once.

text: Because it is spent only after the seal checks out, a forger cannot burn Malika's numbers in advance.
prefix: Because it is spent only after the seal checks out, a forger cannot burn Malika's numbers in advance.

text: One more rule follows.
prefix: One more rule follows.

text: A payment can be taken only for Malika's own website, switched on, with one of its own return addresses.
prefix: A payment can be taken only for Malika's own website, switched on, with one of its own return addresses.

text: Wednesday morning, Bekzod tries it properly.
prefix: Wednesday morning, Bekzod tries it properly.

text: His server builds the body: the website, the order, the amount in cents and the return address.
prefix: His server builds the body: the website, the order, the amount in cents and the return address.

text: It seals the request and sends it.
prefix: It seals the request and sends it.

text: The answer comes back at once.
prefix: The answer comes back at once.

text: The payment is created, and the answer carries the link to the bank's payment page.
prefix: The payment is created, and the answer carries the link to the bank's payment page.

text: In the merchant portal, Malika's payments list shows one new payment, waiting for the buyer.
prefix: In the merchant portal, Malika's payments list shows one new payment, waiting for the buyer.

text: Then Bekzod plays the attacker.
prefix: Then Bekzod plays the attacker.

text: He sends the very same sealed request a second time, unchanged.
prefix: He sends the very same sealed request a second time, unchanged.

text: The bank refuses it, because the one-time number is already used.
prefix: The bank refuses it, because the one-time number is already used.

text: He copies a request, changes the amount, and keeps the old seal.
prefix: He copies a request, changes the amount, and keeps the old seal.

text: The bank refuses it, because the body no longer matches.
prefix: The bank refuses it, because the body no longer matches.

text: He sends a request sealed yesterday.
prefix: He sends a request sealed yesterday.

text: The bank refuses that too, because it is no longer fresh.
prefix: The bank refuses that too, because it is no longer fresh.

text: After every refusal, the payments list stays exactly the same.
prefix: After every refusal, the payments list stays exactly the same.

text: Nothing new is created.
prefix: Nothing new is created.

text: So the token in that support chat is worth nothing on its own.
prefix: So the token in that support chat is worth nothing on its own.

text: Without the seal, it would be a blank cheque in Malika's name.
prefix: Without the seal, it would be a blank cheque in Malika's name.

text: Without the nonce, one recorded request could be sent a thousand times.
prefix: Without the nonce, one recorded request could be sent a thousand times.

text: The seal protects her name and every number in the request.
prefix: The seal protects her name and every number in the request.

text: The time and the nonce protect against copies.
prefix: The time and the nonce protect against copies.

text: And the key safe protects the key itself.
prefix: And the key safe protects the key itself.

text: To recap: the token says who you are, and the seal says this exact request is yours.
prefix: To recap: the token says who you are, and the seal says this exact request is yours.

text: So what makes the leaked token worth nothing?
prefix: So what makes the leaked token worth nothing?

text: The seal, with its time and its one-time number.
prefix: The seal, with its time and its one-time number.
